name: Labour
detail: 2026 party policy specifies capital gains tax and explicitly rules out wealth/inheritance taxes. Individual former ministers require separate evidence.

name: Opportunity
detail: Land-value tax alone is outside this register definition.

name: Sharing Wealth letter signatories
detail: Generic call for wealthy people to pay more tax is insufficient for a wealth-tax bulk import.

name: Better Taxes coalition members
detail: Coalition membership alone does not prove individual member support for net wealth taxation. Require each member endorsement.

name: Public Health Advisory Committee: Determining our Future (2025)
detail: Summary calls for wealth-tax levers, but explanatory text page106 gives capital-gains tax as its concrete wealth-transfer example. No unambiguous net-stock tax design established.

name: Max Harris
detail: Co-author of a 14 July 2020 Spinoff article that describes the Greens' proposed net wealth tax ('both proposed by the Greens in their recent announcement'); the authors do not say they back it. The second co-author (Te Raukura O'Connell Rapira, Laura on the byline) has a separate op-ed that does.

name: Closing the Gap
detail: The 24 Aug 2017 Scoop release quotes its spokesperson only on income tax. The sentence 'a tax on wealth, including capital taxes, should be implemented immediately' is attributed to Graham Robertson (Income Equality Aotearoa).
